copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: Claude 会把 Matrix 适配器从 channels 分支复制进项目并注册，装好固定版本的依赖、修补 ESM 导入后构建，让你的 NanoClaw 能连上任意 Matrix 服务器收发房间与私信，并协助你配好机器人账号凭据。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Matrix 频道，或按步骤配置专用 Matrix 机器人账号与登录凭据时，它就会接管。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 接入 Matrix 频道
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册导入并构建

howto.what_en: When you want to add Matrix support to NanoClaw: it copies the Matrix adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned package, patches ESM imports, then builds — and guides you through setting up a dedicated bot account.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Matrix channel to NanoClaw, or when you follow the steps to configure a dedicated Matrix bot account and credentials.

say_en.note: Copies, registers and builds the adapter

say_en.text: Run /manage-channels to wire Matrix to an agent group
say_en.note: Links this channel to an agent group

say_en.text: My bot account is @andybot:matrix.org — set up the Matrix credentials
